_comment: ONLY what Xero cannot know. The roster itself is built at run time from
Xero inventory items, payroll employees and repeating bills - see
src/roster.py. Nobody has to be added here to be found.
Keyed on the inventory item code, because that is the one stable key. A
person's name arrives as 'Dat Le', 'Dat Tien Le' and 'Le, Dat'; matching
on a name once split one contractor into two and moved $60,000.
folder   - where their files already live on OneDrive, when it does NOT
match <client>_<item name>. Ten years of folders carry typos
('Deepati Bansal') and the misspelling is load-bearing: correct
it here and every existing file stops matching.
name     - the person as everyone refers to them, where the Xero item name
is a fuller legal form.
cadence  - 'monthly' for the offshore team. Default is fortnightly. Monthly
people still file into the CURRENT FORTNIGHT folder - Andrew's
decision, 2 Sep 2026 - so there is one folder to look in, not two.
emails   - an address they also send from. Normally not needed: the address
is read for their name first. Needed only where the address
cannot carry the name, e.g. Bhasker Veela signs 'Veerla Bhaskar'.
skip     - true for a payroll employee who is NOT a swept contractor:
super-only records and monthly salaried staff Andrew runs himself.
They are real employees, so the roster finds them; without this
they are chased every fortnight for a timesheet they never send.
ignore   - true for an inventory item that is not a person at all. Keeps
SEEK ads and training products out of the coverage report.

HSV - MC Hourly._why: Matt Cordner hourly - billed ad hoc, no template

Linfox - BV oncall._why: Bhasker's on-call rate, second item for the same person
